information_loss: reduces each nuclide to its (N, Z) pair; drops spin, excitation spectrum, and binding energy.

ordered_parameter.declaration: ordered by increasing (A, Z): H-1, H-2, He-4, Li-7, C-12, O-16, Ne-20, Mg-24, Si-28, S-32, Ar-36, Ca-40 (alpha-conjugate extension for Z=1..36 coverage)

physical_provenance: nuclide chart (N, Z) counts; standard nuclear data
recurrence_mapping: Neutron/proton ratio N/Z as an exact rational: H-1 0/1, H-2 1/1, He-4 2/2 = 1, Li-7 4/3, C-12 6/6 = 1, O-16 8/8 = 1, Ne-20 10/10 = 1, Mg-24 12/12 = 1, Si-28 14/14 = 1, S-32 16/16 = 1, Ar-36 18/18 = 1, Ca-40 20/20 = 1. The value N/Z = 1 recurs for the even-even N=Z nuclei (He-4 through Ca-40).
